layout.body:
Dear Ms. Edwards,
The reservation for the art workshop that you made on September 10th has been confirmed. The workshop will take place on September 20th at 3:00 PM. All necessary arts supplies will be provided, but please bring your own apron or smock.
Best regards,
Laura Bennett

questions.stem: When is the date of the art workshop?
questions.analysis: When is the date of the art workshop? 原文依据：The workshop will take place on September 20th at 3:00 PM. 工作坊将于 9 月 20 日下午 3 点举行。 (A) September 10th → 错误 (B) September 12th → 错误 (C) September 20th → 正确 (D) September 30th → 错误

questions.stem: What should Ms. Edwards bring to the workshop?
questions.analysis: What should Ms. Edwards bring to the workshop? 原文依据：please bring your own apron or smock. 请自带围裙或罩衣。 (A) 支付方式 → 错误 (B) 额外的颜料 → 错误 (C) 防护衣物 → 正确 (D) 预约凭证 → 错误
